stories.title: YouTube Music launches new labels as AI-generated music floods streaming platforms
stories.dek: The label will appear on the player page and include songs entirely generated by AI or partially, such as AI involved in composition and vocals.

stories.title: Toilet paper and secret recorders: What we know about the arrest of the Saudi OpenAI engineer
stories.dek: Abdulrahman Alfozan had worked for the AI giant for more than a year before he was arrested by the FBI.

stories.title: IA da Meta no WhatsApp cria imagem de 'Flávio 22', mas não de 'Lula 13' e 'Flávio Bolsonaro 22'
stories.dek: Meta diz que proibiu temporariamente imagens de candidatos para cumprir regras eleitorais e ampliou bloqueio a pedidos com primeiro nome e número nas urnas.

stories.title: Eight states sue OpenAI, saying ChatGPT isn’t safe for kids
stories.dek: OpenAI is facing a new wave of lawsuits from eight US states that accuse the company of harming children and misleading customers about the safety of ChatGPT, as reported earlier by Reuters.

stories.title: Tech market sell-off deepens amid fears over US inflation and AI debt
stories.dek: Chip makers and tech investors such as Samsung and SoftBank plunge as traders fret over potential interest rate hikes Business news – live updates Larry Elliott: the global economy is muddling through.

stories.title: Dona do Claude amplia receita em 45% e mira avaliação de US$ 2 trilhões no IPO
stories.dek: Anthropic apresentou receita trimestral e lucro ajustado a investidores enquanto prepara uma abertura de capital que pode avaliar a empresa em US$ 2 trilhões

stories.title: TSMC tem lucro recorde com IA — e ainda não consegue atender à demanda
stories.dek: Fabricante de chips para Nvidia e Apple lucrou US$ 23,6 bilhões no trimestre e prevê crescimento de aproximadamente 44% na receita anual

stories.title: Android is using AI to suss out scammers in Google Messages
stories.dek: Android is introducing new scam defense features that aim to make it easier for users to evade mobile fraud, including bolstered protection in Google Messages and additional safeguarding tools.

stories.title: Empresas podem trocar softwares caros por soluções próprias de IA; entenda a tendência
stories.dek: O avanço da programação assistida por inteligência artificial facilita a criação de ferramentas sob medida, mas manter essas soluções exige planejamento e conhecimento técnico

stories.title: Researchers use AI to design proteins that cut up other proteins
stories.dek: AI design tools make proteins that break bonds that are stable for hundreds of years.

stories.title: Anthropic flags revenue surge to investors ahead of stock market debut
stories.dek: It comes as some investors have become concerned about the amount of money being spent on AI infrastructure.

stories.title: Iowa, Nebraska and six other states are suing OpenAI for endangering children
stories.dek: The lawsuits cover everything from the design of ChatGPT to the company's recent issues with rogue agents.
